name: Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
delivery: Booked through Trailhead Academy and delivered by Pearson VUE, either online proctored (OnVUE) or at a testing center. No hard-copy or online materials allowed during the exam.
maintenance: Complete the Platform App Builder certification maintenance badge on Trailhead once a year (Winter '26 badge due December 4, 2026); the credential expires if you miss the deadline.

sections.title: Salesforce Fundamentals
objectives: Given a scenario, identify the boundaries of declarative customization and the use cases for programmatic customization.
Identify common scenarios for extending an org using the AgentExchange.
Apply features and capabilities available to restrict and extend object, record, and field access.
Given a set of business requirements, determine the appropriate sharing solution.
Identify the features and capabilities available when creating reports, report types, and dashboards.

sections.title: Data Modeling and Management
objectives: Given a scenario, determine the appropriate data model.
Given a scenario, explain the capabilities of the various relationship types and the implications of each on record access, user interface, and reporting.
Given a scenario, determine the considerations when selecting or changing a field data type.
Given a scenario, determine the options and considerations when importing and exporting data, including the capabilities of external data sources.

sections.title: Business Logic and Process Automation
objectives: Given a scenario, demonstrate the use of formula fields to meet stated business requirements.
Given a scenario, determine the capabilities, use cases, and implications of roll-up summary fields.
Given a scenario, demonstrate the use of validation rules to meet stated business requirements.
Create and configure flows using Flow Builder.
Describe the capabilities and use cases for Flow Approval processes.
Given a scenario, determine the appropriate flow type to meet stated business requirements.
Maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot flows.
Describe the capabilities and use cases for using Agentforce to automate business processes.

sections.title: User Interface
objectives: Describe the user interface customization options.
Demonstrate the capabilities and use cases for custom buttons, links, and actions.
Given a scenario, determine the declarative options available for incorporating Lightning components in an application.
Describe the programmatic customizations available for incorporating custom Lightning components in an application.
Given a set of requirements, determine the appropriate global, object-specific actions and layouts to optimize the Salesforce mobile user experience.

sections.title: App Deployment
objectives: Given a set of business requirements, recommend a solution for managing the application lifecycle, including sandbox types.
Given a use case, demonstrate knowledge, viability, and troubleshooting when using change sets.
Describe the use cases and considerations when using unmanaged and managed packages.
Given a scenario, determine the appropriate deployment plan.

tips: Read the official exam guide first and weight study time by section: Business Logic and Process Automation is 32% of the exam, nearly a third.

Work through the official prep trail and the five superbadge units the exam guide recommends (Object Relationships, User Access Fundamentals, Formulas, Data Quality and Validation, Flow Fundamentals).
Practice in a free Developer Edition org or Trailhead Playground; building objects, flows and pages beats reading about them.
Expect short business scenarios; read the last line (what is being asked) before the story.
Many questions ask for the best declarative solution: check if a formula, roll-up summary, validation rule or flow solves it before reaching for code.
Multiple-select questions tell you how many answers to choose; all must be correct to score.
There is no penalty for guessing, so answer every question and flag uncertain ones for review.
Budget under 2 minutes per question (up to 65 questions in 105 minutes) and leave 10 minutes to revisit flagged items.
Up to 5 unscored questions are mixed in; don't let an odd question rattle you.
Know the data model limits cold: 2 master-detail and 40 relationships per custom object, 25 roll-up summary fields, 10 unique cross-object relationships in formulas.
Questions align to the Summer '26 release; newer Help pages may describe features that arrived later.
For online proctoring, run the Pearson VUE system test in advance, clear your desk, and check in early with a valid government-issued ID.
Schedule the exam date first; a fixed deadline keeps a 4-6 week plan on track.

Complete Formulas and Validations and the Formulas superbadge unit

Complete the Flow Fundamentals superbadge unit

notes: Name: the exam guide and credential page call it 'Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder'. The credential page links a Trailhead Academy exam page whose URL ends in 'Plat-Admn-202', which suggests the exam code, but that page wasn't reachable from here and the guide shows no code, so the code is left out.

Release: the exam guide (read 2026-11-16) says questions align to the Summer '26 ('SU '26') release. The Help pages read on the same day are newer and describe some later changes: Flow Builder's Test Mode replaces Debug for autolaunched and record-triggered flows, DevOps Center is now called Lifecycle Center, and Agentforce-assisted troubleshooting is in beta. Question writers should avoid questions that depend on these changes or give the older name too.

Maintenance: the exam guide says the maintenance badge is due 'three times a year', but the Trailhead Certification Release Maintenance Schedule (read 2026-11-16) lists Platform App Builder as an annual Winter-cycle badge (Winter '26 badge available December 11, 2025, due December 4, 2026). The schedule is newer and specific, so this file uses it; the guide's sentence looks out of date.
Passing score: the guide says 73%. Older study materials may quote a different number; the guide is the source of truth.
Weights: the exam guide gives 18/20/32/17/13. The recommended trailmix still shows older weights (23/22/28/17/10); this file uses the guide.
AgentExchange: the guide and Trailhead modules now say 'AgentExchange' for the marketplace formerly called AppExchange. Keep the exam wording and mention the old name once.

Cert Prep: unlike PD1, no dedicated 'Cert Prep: Platform App Builder' modules were found (Trailhead search didn't render, and the guessed URLs returned 404). The official prep is the trail, the trailmix and the five superbadge units the guide lists. Not proven absent.
Unscored items: the guide says 'up to five'; 5 is the maximum, not a guaranteed count.

Delivery: Trailhead Academy booking and Pearson VUE delivery (OnVUE online or a testing center) are confirmed by the Trailhead help article 'Scheduling an Exam'; the guide itself only says 'onsite at a testing center or in an online environment'.

Roll-up summaries: the relationships overview says lookup relationships don't support roll-up summary fields, but the current roll-up summary article also has a sentence about lookup fields in COUNT/SUM roll-ups. Teach roll-ups as master-detail only (plus the standard exceptions such as Account from Opportunity) and don't write questions on lookup roll-ups.
Pricing in currencies other than USD and JPY was not checked.

boss.defeat: The first master-detail… is the primary. Croak…

boss.name: The Flow Hydra
boss.taunt: Before save or after save? Pick wrong and I’ll update forever!
boss.defeat: Fast field updates… before save… my one weakness…

boss.name: The Action Kraken
boss.taunt: Eight arms, eight buttons! Which one is global? Blub!
boss.defeat: Object-specific… it knows its record… blub.

boss.defeat: Every dependency… in the set… deploy… complete.
